beats.label: 蹬阶跃下
beats.detail: Explosively, the challenger releases his loaded knees and leaps south from the landing, eyes fixed ahead, ponytail and sash streaming behind.

beats.label: 鞋底触石
beats.detail: At normal speed his soles hit the northern dais at 1.25 seconds; knees compress, a tight dust puff follows contact, jaw clenched.

beats.label: 卸力站稳
beats.detail: He rises deliberately from the landing crouch, lowers the blade and plants both feet; coat overshoots then settles, gaze unwavering.

beats.label: 透视压近
beats.detail: Hold his upright torso and intent expression still while the background compresses behind him; dust subsides, the red sash loses momentum.

beats.label: 三米对峙
beats.detail: Hold the settled stance three metres from the keeper, sword down and breathing controlled; no extra step or attack.

beats.label: 单一机位
beats.detail: One dolly zoom after landing holds torso scale and ends still, background compressed; one continuous shot, no cut.

continuity.exit: Challenger at (0,3,0.15), facing south toward the offscreen keeper, upright after landing, right-hand sword lowered, feet planted; keeper at (0,0,0.15), facing north, sword lowered; three metres apart, dust settled, no contact.

board.prompt: Create ONE cinematic storyboard still, 16:9, premium painterly 3D Chinese wuxia animated feature, not a photo. Reference 1 = white keeper identity and clothing ONLY; reference 2 = teal challenger identity and clothing ONLY; reference 3 = courtyard architecture, materials and dusk palette ONLY, not its camera or exact staircase count. Exactly two adult men except when specified offscreen. One plain straight jian each, empty scabbards, no extra weapon. Same grey stone low dais, muted red flags, warm western rim light. No captions, text, panel layout or montage. Medium full-body landing aftermath, camera slightly west of south looking north, height 2m, 35mm. Only teal challenger prominent, standing firmly on northern dais, sword lowered, jaw tense, dust around boots. White keeper is offscreen toward camera. Northern stairs directly behind him, bell tower background right. Freeze at 2.5 seconds before dolly zoom begins.
